note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation 5 list as published (Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are written in our own words for this entry; where a method is not yet confirmed by any published guide, the guide says so. Only Positive Mental Attitude is flagged possibly missable, by GTABase and PowerPyx; no confirmed missable list exists yet (PlanetGTA6, 21 Nov 2026). All 55 trophies are offline, single-player; there are no online trophies.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order (story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles, crime, then 100% completion) and the platinum is the last one to pop.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked by the in-game checklist. It is the longest grind in the list and the last gold before the platinum: finish the story, the stranger strands, all activities and collectibles first, then clear whatever the checklist still shows. KeenGamer and GamesFuze both call it the hardest trophy in the set.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and airtime the game counts as you drive and ride around; they build up naturally during play, then mop up the remainder late in the game by chaining jumps and stunts in open areas. The 250 count is from the official description (KeenGamer).
